entries.note: District: Ibirapuera.  Mobile number (11) 94242-0894 shown on page; link targets differed, not used.

entries.name: Veros Hospital Veterinário
entries.address: Av. Brigadeiro Luís Antônio, 4643, Jardim Paulista, 01401-002
entries.duty: Emergency and general reception open 24 hours. Appointment desk Mon-Fri 8:00-21:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 8:00-20:00. WhatsApp +55 11 94107 9961.

entries.name: Hospital Veterinário Municipal Leste (Tatuapé)
entries.address: Av. Salim Farah Maluf, esquina com R. Ulisses Cruz, 285, Tatuapé
entries.duty: Public hospital for dogs and cats of São Paulo residents enrolled in social programmes; open every day, 24 hours. Between 17:00 and 07:00 and on weekends and holidays only urgent and emergency cases. Free city line 156.
entries.note: No unit phone on official page; Secretaria Municipal da Saúde (11) 5461-5600 and 156 only. Confirmed also by prefeitura news pages (Leste 24 h).

entries.name: Hospital Veterinário Municipal Leste II (São Miguel Paulista)
entries.address: Av. Nordestina, 225, esquina com Rua Daniel Bernardo, 107, São Miguel Paulista
entries.duty: Free public hospital for dogs and cats of low-income São Paulo residents (social programmes). Mon-Fri 7:00-17:00, except holidays. Not open 24 hours. City line 156.
entries.note: Social screening for residents without active benefits on Tuesdays from 14:00. No unit phone on official page.

entries.name: Hospital Veterinário Municipal Sul (Jurubatuba)
entries.duty: Free public hospital for dogs and cats of low-income São Paulo residents (social programmes). Daily 7:00-17:00; weekends and holidays only urgent and emergency cases. Not open 24 hours. City line 156.
entries.note: Social screening for residents without active benefits on Mondays from 14:00. No unit phone on official page.

entries.name: Hospital Veterinário Municipal Norte (Casa Verde)
entries.duty: Free public hospital for dogs and cats of low-income São Paulo residents (social programmes). Mon-Fri 7:00-17:00, except holidays. Not open 24 hours. City line 156.
entries.note: Social screening for residents without active benefits on Wednesdays from 14:00. No unit phone on official page.

entries.name: Hospital Veterinário Municipal Oeste (Butantã)
entries.address: Av. Professor Orlando Marques de Paiva, 87, Butantã (USP)
entries.duty: Free public hospital for dogs and cats of low-income São Paulo residents (social programmes). Mon-Fri 7:00-17:00, except holidays; first come, first served from 07:00. Not open 24 hours. City line 156.
entries.note: Non-emergency cases after social screening. No unit phone on official page.

entries.name: Hospital Veterinário USP (HOVET FMVZ)
entries.address: Av. Prof. Dr. Orlando Marques de Paiva, 87, Cidade Universitária, 05508-270
entries.duty: University teaching hospital. Triage Mon-Fri 7:00-10:00 with tickets handed out at 07:00; consultations and tests are paid. Phone answered from 14:00, WhatsApp 8:00-16:30. No emergency or 24-hour service stated.
entries.note: Home page lists (11) 3091-1320; atendimento page lists 11 3091-1306 for hospital-escola info and 156 for public free service.

entries.name: Hospital Veterinário Municipal de São José dos Campos
entries.duty: Municipal hospital partly open: vaccination and microchipping Mon-Fri 8:30-16:00, no appointment. Full care and 24-hour emergency are planned but not yet available. Phone is the city hall line.
entries.note: Status 19/08/2026: management call published, proposals due 21/09/2026; recheck. Old Univap-based hospital details not confirmed.

entries.name: Hospital Veterinário Municipal "Cão Mayke"
entries.address: Rua Nelson Cardoso Marques, em frente ao nº 383, Jardim Betânia, Zona Norte
entries.duty: Municipal hospital. Mon-Fri 8:00-17:00 and Sat 8:00-13:00; outside these hours only urgent and emergency cases after triage. Urgent care free for Sorocaba residents; other care for registered low-income owners. Phone is WhatsApp.
entries.note: Opening-article hours; a second city article says urgent cases only 24 Dec-4 Jan (holiday rota). Not described as 24 h.

entries.name: Clínica Veterinária Meu Pet
entries.duty: Free municipal clinic for dogs and cats of Ribeirão Preto residents. Mon-Sat 7:00-17:00; emergencies seen without appointment. Not open 24 hours.
entries.note: Official ribeiraopreto.sp.gov.br pages blocked by robots; data from Correio da Manhã news article only; no phone found. Verify hours.

notes: Region: São Paulo state. No official animal poison line found (CIATox/CEATOX are human lines). No duty rotas. Not done: many private 24 h hospitals in São Paulo city (Hospital Veterinário Rebouças, Pompeia, Prontvet, Santa Inês, Vet Popular, Dog Up, Vet Caldas, Vetnasa, Paes de Barros) because clinic sites could not be fetched (only URLs surfaced by search can be opened) - leads from Catraca Livre; Campinas private hospitals, Santos/Baixada (municipal hospital still under construction in 2025, Bom Retiro), Ribeirão Preto private 24 h (Marcovet, VFP, Bmvet), PUC-Campinas hospital (24 h contract with city for rescued animals, Campus II, Jardim Ipaussurama), UNESP Araçatuba/Botucatu/Jaboticabal, UNIP, Anhembi Morumbi, Guarujá, other states of Brazil.
